name: Bunni
title: Levite Who Sealed the Covenant
summary: Bunni was a Levite who lived in the post-exilic period, after the Jews had returned to Jerusalem. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the Levites who participated in public prayer and confession, and as one of those who sealed the covenant with God under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Prayer and Confession on a Day of Fasting
keyEvents.description: Bunni was among the Levites who cried out with a loud voice to the Lord their God during a great assembly where the people fasted, confessed their sins, and read from the Book of the Law.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Bunni was one of the Levites who placed his seal on the written covenant in which the people committed themselves to follow God's law under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: The People Renew Their Covenant
keyEvents.description: As part of the group of Levites, Bunni took part in the solemn renewal of the covenant with God, where the people promised to keep God's commands and statutes.

keyEvents.title: Reading of the Law
keyEvents.description: In connection with the great assembly where Ezra read the law, the Levites, including Binnui, helped explain the law to the people and lead them in worship.
